clips.title: The story
paras: Spirit Rock is a sacred crag perched in the rugged bluffs above the Valley of Trials in Durotar. Reached by a winding trail known as the Hidden Path, it serves as a secluded holy site where initiates commune directly with the elemental forces of the land.

Overlooking the red canyon where young Horde warriors and scouts begin their training, Spirit Rock stands as an altar of communion. Isolated from the clatter of the Valley of Trials, it is approached only via the Hidden Path winding up the rocky ridgeline. Aspiring shaman make pilgrimages to this desolate outcrop to drink the traditional sapta, piercing the veil of the physical world to hear the rumblings and whisperings of the earth itself.
